Zara (CS): FYI Meditrack renewal 2026-06-07. Usage down 59% last 30d; active seats 24 -> 9. Champion left last week.

Evan (CSM): Any sign of errors or a competitor trial?

Zara (CS): Procurement says they're running a 2-week spike with AtlasAI starting Monday.

Priya (RevOps): Billing snapshot: embeddings -61%, generation tokens -48%. No billing disputes.

Noah (Eng): No infra errors. Recommend an objective bake-off + Dedicated-lite trial to prove perf and quality parity.

Kai (Support): One ticket quoting lower per-embedding price; I asked for sample dataset.

Evan (CSM): Proposed play: (1) 10-day Dedicated-lite POC; (2) blind bake-off with seeded metrics; (3) retention package (enablement credit + trial pricing) if we win. I'll run outreach.

Priya (RevOps): I'll draft a POC concession: 25% off embedding units during POC and a $9k enablement credit on a 12-month conversion (needs finance ok).

Noah (Eng): I'll prepare an 800-doc harness and deterministic evals (precision@5, avg cosine gap, tail latency). Will push to /shared/meditrack/bakeoff. Repro snippet:
```
python infra/bench.py --data meditrack_800.json --model rwd-embed-small --batch 128
```

trial-bot: Dedicated-lite instance meditrack-poc-01 provisioned (expires in 10 days).

Zara (CS): Evan, include Head of Data (Jules) and Procurement (lynne@meditrack) on invite. Success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.77, 95th pct latency <= 140ms.

Evan (CSM): Invite sent for Tue 10am PT. Owners: Priya (pricing/waiver), Noah (bench), Kai (support). Reconvene after bake-off with results and recommend retention play. :white_check_mark:
